tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The BDCOM GP-3600-08-2AC 8-Port EPON OLT is a carrier-grade Optical Line Terminal designed to deliver reliable, high-speed fiber access for Internet Service Providers (ISPs), enterprise networks, and FTTH (Fiber to the Home) deployments. Built with 8 EPON PON ports, 4 Gigabit RJ45 uplink ports, 4 high-speed 10G SFP+ uplink ports, and dual hot-swappable AC power supplies, this OLT provides excellent performance, redundancy, and scalability for modern optical access networks.


Compliant with the IEEE 802.3ah EPON standard, the GP-3600-08-2AC supports high-density subscriber connections while ensuring stable network operation. Advanced Layer 2 and Layer 3 features, including VLAN, QoS, ACL, IGMP Snooping, IPv4/IPv6 routing, and comprehensive security mechanisms, make it an ideal solution for telecom operators, data centers, government organizations, universities, and enterprise campuses.


Its 1U rackmount design allows easy deployment in network cabinets, while the redundant dual AC power modules maximize service uptime. Whether you're expanding an existing FTTH infrastructure or building a new EPON network, the BDCOM GP-3600-08-2AC delivers carrier-class reliability and outstanding network efficiency.


Key Features


  • 8 EPON PON Ports for high-density fiber access
  • 4 × Gigabit RJ45 uplink ports
  • 4 × 10G SFP+ uplink interfaces
  • Dual Hot-Swappable AC Power Supplies
  • IEEE 802.3ah EPON compliant
  • Supports up to 1:64 optical split ratio per PON port
  • Layer 2 & Layer 3 switching capabilities
  • IPv4 and IPv6 dual-stack support
  • Advanced QoS, VLAN, ACL, and Multicast management
  • IGMP Snooping and IGMP Proxy support
  • SNMP, CLI, Web GUI, SSH, and Telnet management
  • Secure authentication and network protection features
  • 1U 19-inch rackmount design
  • Ideal for FTTH, FTTB, FTTO, and ISP applications
